summary: Iteration 2 - Founder/Super Admin portal end-to-end testing. Added /app/backend/tests/test_founder_portal.py with 28 tests covering: founder dashboard (5 range values), schools extended create+details+admins+duplicate-code 409, SUSPEND blocks school users' login and reactivate restores it (CRITICAL passed), per-school module gating disables attendance both client (nav) and server (POST /api/attendance -> 403), plans CRUD + persistence, subscription assignment, global users w/ school_name enrichment + disable/enable blocks login, global search by school code and admin email, announcements all-vs-targeted isolation, system health, platform settings persistence, audit logs record founder actions. Result: 28/28 PASS in 9.8s. Previous iteration_1 suite (32/32) still valid; combined regression 60/60. Frontend UI verified via Playwright: founder login auto-routes to /app Master Console with all stat cards + Today/Week/Month/Year/All-time range filter functional, sidebar navigation for Dashboard, All Schools, Global Users, Plans, Subscriptions, Feature Modules, Announcements, Audit Logs, System Health, Platform Settings all load with 0 errors, global search input returns matching TEST schools with code+city, Platform Settings form displays and persists session timeout=45. All expected data-testids present (founder-sidebar-nav, nav-*, range-*, global-search-input, stat-*, logout-button, header-username).
critical_code_review_comments: Login route correctly blocks non-founder users when school.status != 'active' with 403 (routes_auth.py L64-73); returns explicit 'suspended' language required by spec.
require_module dependency (auth_utils L140) correctly bypasses founder and enforces enabled_modules on POST /api/attendance.
attach_school_context enriches /auth/me & /auth/login responses with enabled_modules so frontend can gate nav — implemented and returned.
routes_platform.global_search uses re.escape() to prevent regex injection — good; case-insensitive; scans schools by name/code/city, users by name/email.
routes_announcements list filter uses target_type=all OR school_ids contains sid + status active + start/expiry date window — targeted isolation confirmed via test.
routes_users.set_status increments token_version, invalidating any existing session for disabled user (verified indirectly: login returns 403 for status!=active).
MINOR: routes_platform.global_search does an extra bson import via __import__ inside a loop — cosmetic; consider top-level import.
MINOR: routes_platform.health imports storage.init_storage inside try — fine but could be cached; storage returned 'operational' in test.
MINOR: routes_dashboard.stats top_schools performs O(N) count_documents per school in a loop; will not scale beyond a few hundred schools — consider aggregation pipeline when scale increases.
MINOR: /api/schools/{id}/subscription overwrites the whole subscription object with model_dump defaults — acceptable (spec matches), but PATCH-semantic would prefer merging.
OBSERVATION: seed_founder idempotency + bcrypt/httpOnly cookies still verified via iteration_1 suite. No security regressions found.
